# The design sample compiles but cannot be enacted yet: its NATS
# slice is refused at plan time — slice lifecycle is deliberately
# unimplemented — as a configuration fault, exit 2, and the plan fault
# preempts the extern gate (the sample's unbound externs never get a
# say). The refusal wording is enact's pin; the relay and the
# preemption order are this one.
[short] skip 'drives the go toolchain'

status 2 sdl run $SDLREPO/examples/sample
stderr 'slice provisioning is not implemented: natsAccount provisions substrate\.NATS as a slice \(attach only\)'
! stderr 'unbound extern'
! stdout .
